cases.name: Convert to Slime
cases.text:
Destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, and up to one target enchantment.
Then if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, create an X/X green Ooze creature token, where X is the total mana value of permanents destroyed this way.
